claim: Estimated savings are EUR 6,400 per year without affecting planned activities.
evidence: The review covered eleven products with annual costs. Three annotation tools have fewer than five monthly logins, and one has not been used since October. The reference manager and diagram service show regular use. GPU monitoring software is used daily and must be renewed.
The proposal is to cancel the unused annotation tool, reduce another licence from twenty to ten accounts, and temporarily retain the third until ARIADNA evaluation ends.
